# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and the package/project it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the affected package/project tests.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_repository.py`.
- [ ] I updated documentation/status metadata when behavior or publication state changed.
- [ ] I did not commit the paid Master PDF/DOCX/EPUB or commercial publishing source assets.
- [ ] I did not add a mutable X/Twitter profile URL to permanent metadata.
- [ ] I updated checksums when intentionally changing a checksummed package file.

## Database scope

State which database engine(s) were actually used for execution/testing. Do not claim PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server/Oracle execution if only static or model tests were run.

## Notes / known limitations

List anything reviewers should know before merge.
